name: kairos
description: Payment-health defence for Indian merchants. Detect a rail degrading, steer traffic off it under provable bounds, recover the casualties.
author: Ameya Borkar

scripts.bench:detect: pnpm --filter @kairos/bench run build && pnpm --filter @kairos/bench run detect-curve
scripts.bench:detect:quick: pnpm --filter @kairos/bench run build && pnpm --filter @kairos/bench run detect-curve:quick
scripts.bench:spend: pnpm --filter @kairos/bench run build && pnpm --filter @kairos/bench run spend-bound
scripts.bench:spend:quick: pnpm --filter @kairos/bench run build && pnpm --filter @kairos/bench run spend-bound:quick
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
